own.notes: Predicts total GBP pence for integer quantities 1..1000. Select the segment with the greatest from value not exceeding the quantity, evaluate constant + linear*quantity + quadratic*quantity^2, and round to nonnegative integer pence. The inclusive ranges are 1..251, 252..648 and 649..1000. Broad exploration and adjacent-quantity probes identified and confirmed both slope changes. This predictor exactly matches all 190 distinct successfully observed own-context quantities, including 133 additional validation quantities queried after the model was frozen. On those 133 validation observations, exact-match, within-1% and within-5% rates were all 100%; maximum absolute error was 0 pence. Observations include both domain endpoints, with at most six unqueried integers between consecutive sampled quantities. Confidence is high, but the remaining 810 quantities were not observed: the validation results are not a proof of exhaustive equality or a guarantee against an unseen exceptional rule.

other.notes: Transferred unchanged from the own-context reconstruction because the disclosed shared-rule policy explicitly states that both contexts use the identical pricing function. Use the same GBP-pence evaluation and inclusive quantity ranges as own. No other-context prices were successfully observed: get for other-seed and create for other at quantity 333 both returned HTTP 403, context unavailable. Consequently, there is no directly measured other-context validation accuracy. Confidence rests on the stated identical-function policy and the own model's exact agreement with 190 observations, including 133 post-freeze validation quantities. This predictor inherits the own model's uncertainty at unqueried quantities; transferred predictions are not presented as observed other-context outputs.
